property_summary: For any input where _tos is empty, transfer must revert (require(_tos.length > 0)); the mutant removes this so an empty-array call returns true instead of reverting.
For any input, transfer must revert whenever any transferFrom call to the counterparty fails; the buggy version silently returns true instead.

For any amounts v0,v1 within a token cap, each recipient must receive its own v[i], so a batch transfer with v0+v1 <= cap succeeds; the mutant sends v[0] to everyone and reverts whenever 2*v0 > cap (possible whenever v0 > v1).
A transfer over one recipient must actually invoke that recipient's transferFrom (recorded by a reverting-less fallback), not skip it.

property_summary: For a single recipient, transfer must attempt the transferFrom call, so if the target contract reverts (its fallback reverts), transfer must revert; the mutant skips the call and completes.
Every recipient in _tos must receive a transferFrom call: when all recipients are this test contract, the number of fallback invocations recorded must equal _tos.length.

For any nonempty recipient list, transfer must actually attempt the transferFrom for the LAST recipient; so if the token contract (this test) reverts only when the recipient equals the last entry, transfer must revert.
With two recipients where the token accepts the first transferFrom (value 0) but reverts on the second (nonzero value), transfer must revert because it attempts every recipient including the last.
